meta.subject: English
meta.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions
meta.title: Spot the Pause: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The experiment worked—barely, what does the dash do?
choices: Set off a final word that qualifies the main clause
Introduce a list of possible experimental results
Mark words deliberately left out of the sentence
Separate a direct address from the rest of the statement
questions.explanation: The dash sets off barely, a final word that qualifies the statement that the experiment worked.
questions.skill: Identify dashes that set off final qualifiers
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence 'We packed water, maps, bandages—and a lantern,' what does the dash do?
choices: It separates the final list item from the rest of the list.
It sets off and emphasizes the final list item.
It introduces a direct quotation after the list.
It marks the first list item as a parenthetical addition.
questions.explanation: The dash sets off and emphasizes the final item in the list, a lantern.
questions.skill: Identifying dashes before final list items
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The team, however, won the game," which punctuation marks set off the transitional word "however" to show a pause?
choices: ellipsis
dashes
commas
semicolons
questions.explanation: The commas surrounding "however" create a brief pause in the sentence.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "He said, \"I can't believe—\" and stopped," which punctuation mark marks an abrupt break in speech?
choices: ellipsis
dash
comma
colon
questions.explanation: The em dash after "believe" marks an abrupt break in speech.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The memo read, 'Please review the attached...'", which punctuation mark shows that words have been omitted from the quoted memo?
choices: comma
dash
ellipsis
semicolon
questions.explanation: The three periods (ellipsis) indicate that part of the original memo has been left out.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function for pauses and omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The road flooded, closing the lower route," what does the comma do?
choices: It joins two independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction.
It separates the main clause from a result phrase.
It sets off an appositive naming a person.
It separates items in a series.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the main clause from the participial phrase closing the lower route, which describes the result of the flooding.
questions.skill: Identify a comma before a result phrase
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The director announced the delay—because of heavy rain—before the crowd arrived, why are the dashes used?
choices: They show that the sentence should be read as a question.
They mark a pause where a word has been omitted.
They set off an explanatory interruption.
They introduce a quoted speaker's exact words.
questions.explanation: The dashes set off the reason for the delay as an interruption within the main statement.
questions.skill: Recognizing a dash around an interruption
questions.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence Hiking boots, wool socks, and a raincoat were lined by the door, what do the commas do?
choices: Mark the end of a direct quotation.
Separate an introductory clause from the main clause.
Set off a parenthetical phrase within the sentence.
Separate three items in the series.
questions.explanation: The commas separate the three items in the list of hiking gear.
questions.skill: Using commas in a series
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "She hesitated... then continued," which punctuation mark shows a pause or omission?
choices: ellipsis
dash
comma
semicolon
questions.explanation: The three dots (ellipsis) indicate a trailing pause and omitted words in the sentence.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: The protester shouted, "Down with the old system!" After an editor removed the quoted words, the sentence read: The next morning, the newspaper printed only... in its report. What words do the ellipsis stand for?
choices: Down with the old system
The next morning
The newspaper
The protester
questions.explanation: The ellipsis replaces the quoted words "Down with the old system," which the editor removed from the report.
questions.skill: Identify omitted words represented by an ellipsis
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The coach, her clipboard in hand, called the team together, what do the commas do?
choices: Join two independent clauses with a conjunction
Set off an absolute phrase that describes the coach
Introduce the subject and verb of the sentence
Mark the end of a direct quotation
questions.explanation: The commas set off the absolute phrase her clipboard in hand, which describes the coach.
questions.skill: Identify commas around absolute phrases
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The instructions were clear—except the final step, which punctuation mark introduces the exception?
choices: An ellipsis
A colon
A comma
A dash
questions.explanation: The dash sets off the phrase except the final step to make the exception clear.
questions.skill: Identify dashes that introduce exceptions
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The alarm sounded—everyone scrambled for the exits," which punctuation mark signals an abrupt shift from the alarm to the reaction?
choices: semicolon
comma
ellipsis
dash
questions.explanation: The dash links the alarm directly to the immediate, sudden reaction that follows.
questions.skill: identify punctuation function
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "We waited... and waited... but no one came," which punctuation marks indicate omitted words or trailing pauses?
choices: period
dash
comma
ellipsis
questions.explanation: Each set of three dots (ellipsis) shows a pause and omitted continuation.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: The full sentence is The twins studied biology, and Maria studied biology. Which shortened version uses ellipsis to omit the repeated word?
choices: The twins studied..., and Maria studied biology.
The twins studied biology, and Maria studied...
The twins studied biology..., and Maria studied biology.
The twins studied...biology, and Maria studied biology.
questions.explanation: The ellipsis in the second version stands for the repeated word biology at the end of the sentence.
questions.skill: Using ellipsis to omit a repeated word
questions.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "I wonder if...", which punctuation mark shows that the speaker's thought trails off unfinished?
choices: ellipsis
dash
comma
question mark
questions.explanation: The ellipsis indicates the speaker leaves the sentence incomplete, suggesting hesitation or an unfinished idea.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function in a sentence
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence The engine purred... then stalled without warning, what does the ellipsis most clearly convey?
choices: A contrast between two complete sentences
A missing list of engine parts
A direct quotation left without quotation marks
A brief hesitation before the sudden change
questions.explanation: The ellipsis creates a brief hesitation before the engine's sudden stall.
questions.skill: Interpreting ellipses as pauses
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which version correctly uses a comma to separate two independent clauses joined by yet?
choices: The evidence was incomplete yet, the team reached a conclusion.
The evidence was incomplete, yet the team reached a conclusion.
The evidence, was incomplete yet the team reached a conclusion.
The evidence was incomplete, yet, the team reached a conclusion.
questions.explanation: The comma before yet separates the two independent clauses joined by the coordinating conjunction yet.
questions.skill: Using a comma before a coordinating conjunction
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The novel, which won several awards, is on the shelf," what do the commas do?
choices: introduce a list
join two independent clauses
indicate omitted words
set off a nonrestrictive clause
questions.explanation: The pair of commas encloses the nonrestrictive relative clause that adds extra information about the novel.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function in a sentence
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "She whispered, \"I... I don't know.\"" which punctuation marks show hesitation within the quoted speech?
choices: dash
ellipsis
comma
question mark
questions.explanation: The ellipsis inside the quotation represents the speaker's hesitation.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence Wow, that was close! what does the comma after Wow do?
choices: It marks a pause before a list of three items.
It sets off the name of the person being addressed.
It separates two independent clauses joined by and.
It separates an introductory interjection from the main statement.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the introductory interjection Wow from the main statement.
questions.skill: Using commas after interjections
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "She was about to leave—then the phone rang," which punctuation mark signals an abrupt change in direction?
choices: comma
ellipsis
dash
semicolon
questions.explanation: The dash marks a sudden shift from the planned action to the unexpected interruption.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function in a sentence
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The answer—if there is one—remains unknown," which punctuation marks set off the parenthetical clause for emphasis and pause?
choices: dashes
commas
ellipsis
parentheses
questions.explanation: The pair of em dashes encloses the clause, marking a strong pause on each side.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation indicating pauses or omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses a comma to join two independent clauses?
choices: The bell rang, and the students entered.
Although the bell rang, the students entered.
The bell rang and, the students entered.
The bell rang; the students entered.
questions.explanation: The comma before and separates two independent clauses, making the sentence grammatically correct.
questions.skill: Joining independent clauses with commas
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence The instructions were precise—yet the test was confusing, what does the dash signal?
choices: A contrast between precise instructions and a confusing test
An omission of repeated words
A pause after an introductory transition
A separation between three test results
questions.explanation: The dash introduces the contrasting word yet to emphasize the difference between the precise instructions and confusing test.
questions.skill: Recognizing contrasts signaled by dashes
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence 'However, the rain continued,' what does the comma after However do?
choices: It separates an introductory transition from the main clause.
It introduces a list of three items.
It marks the end of a direct quotation.
It separates two coordinate adjectives.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the introductory transition However from the main clause the rain continued.
questions.skill: Identifying commas after sentence-initial transitions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The team celebrated—victory was finally theirs.", what does the dash accomplish?
choices: marks a pause before a transition
separates two independent clauses
indicates omitted words
sets off and emphasizes the final clause
questions.explanation: The dash isolates the concluding clause, giving it strong emphasis.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function for pauses and omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence He did not call, nor did he write, what does the comma do?
choices: Introduce a dependent clause before the main clause
Set off a nonessential phrase in the middle of the sentence
Mark the beginning of a list of three items
Separate two independent clauses joined by nor
questions.explanation: The comma separates the independent clause He did not call from the independent clause nor did he write.
questions.skill: Use commas with coordinating conjunctions
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses paired dashes correctly to set off an appositive that identifies a person?
choices: Ms. Iyer—a robotics coach—led the workshop.
Ms. Iyer—a robotics coach led the workshop.
Ms. Iyer, a robotics coach—led the workshop.
Ms. Iyer—a robotics coach, led the workshop.
questions.explanation: The paired dashes set off the appositive a robotics coach, which identifies Ms. Iyer.
questions.skill: Recognizing paired dashes around an appositive
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence 'Yes, I will reconsider the offer,' what does the comma after Yes do?
choices: It marks the end of a direct quotation.
It introduces a list of three items.
It separates two coordinate adjectives.
It separates an introductory response from the main statement.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the introductory response Yes from the main statement I will reconsider the offer.
questions.skill: Identifying commas after introductory responses
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence 'The narrow, winding road led to school,' what does the comma after narrow do?
choices: It introduces a list of three items.
It marks the end of a direct quotation.
It separates the first coordinate adjective from the second.
It sets off a nonrestrictive clause.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the coordinate adjectives narrow and winding, each of which describes the road.
questions.skill: Identifying commas between coordinate adjectives
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which version correctly sets off the appositive that identifies Ms. Patel?
choices: Ms. Patel, our history teacher, led the workshop.
Ms. Patel our history teacher, led the workshop.
Ms. Patel our history teacher led the workshop.
Ms. Patel, our history teacher led the workshop.
questions.explanation: The two commas correctly set off the appositive our history teacher, which identifies Ms. Patel.
questions.skill: Pairing commas around an appositive
questions.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The sign read, 'Keep off the grass...'", which punctuation mark shows that words have been omitted from the quoted sign?
choices: dash
ellipsis
comma
period
questions.explanation: The three periods together form an ellipsis that marks the omission of words in the quotation.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function in a sentence
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the line "I thought we had agreed...", the three dots show that the speaker's thought:
choices: is a direct quote
trails off unfinished
contains a list
is a question
questions.explanation: The ellipsis indicates the speaker leaves the sentence incomplete, letting the thought fade.
questions.skill: identify punctuation function
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence Outside, the rain drummed against the roof, what does the comma after Outside do?
choices: It joins two complete sentences with a coordinating conjunction
It sets off the introductory adverb from the main clause
It introduces a quoted phrase before the main clause
It separates items in a series
questions.explanation: The comma sets off the introductory adverb Outside from the main clause.
questions.skill: Identifying commas after introductory elements
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The mural, painted by local students, brightened the hallway," what do the commas do?
choices: They introduce a direct quotation.
They separate three items in a series.
They join two independent clauses.
They set off extra information about the mural.
questions.explanation: The paired commas set off the participial phrase painted by local students, which adds nonessential information about the mural.
questions.skill: Identify commas around nonessential information
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The path looked clear—until we saw the fallen tree, what does the dash signal?
choices: It signals that several words have been omitted.
It signals that the sentence is spoken in a quotation.
It signals a reversal or unexpected turn in the thought.
It signals that a list of examples is about to begin.
questions.explanation: The dash signals the unexpected turn from thinking the path was clear to discovering the fallen tree.
questions.skill: Recognizing a dash for an unexpected turn
questions.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence Now—stop!, what does the dash do?
choices: Introduce a quotation from another speaker
Show that a list of items is incomplete
Emphasize the sudden command that follows
Separate a subordinate clause from the main clause
questions.explanation: The dash places emphasis on the abrupt command stop and strengthens the sense of urgency.
questions.skill: Recognize dashes used for emphasis
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence He murmured, Perhaps..., what does the ellipsis show?
choices: That the speaker leaves the thought unfinished
That the speaker introduces a quotation
That the speaker gives a command
That the speaker states a cause and effect
questions.explanation: The ellipsis after Perhaps shows that the speaker does not complete the thought.
questions.skill: Interpret ellipses in dialogue
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence The crowd erupted—'Champion!' what does the dash do?
choices: It signals that the speaker has finished.
It introduces the quoted reaction.
It shows that a word has been omitted.
It marks a list of three audience responses.
questions.explanation: The dash introduces the crowd's quoted reaction without a quotation tag.
questions.skill: Using dashes before quoted reactions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "He finally agreed—reluctantly," what does the dash accomplish?
choices: omits repeated words
emphasizes the final qualifying word
separates items in a series
introduces a quotation
questions.explanation: The dash places strong focus on the adverb "reluctantly" that qualifies the agreement.
questions.skill: Identify punctuation function in a sentence
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence Before the referee could blow the whistle, the runner crossed the line, what does the comma do?
choices: It joins two independent clauses that could stand alone.
It shows that a word has been omitted from the sentence.
It sets off a parenthetical phrase in the middle of the sentence.
It marks a brief pause after the introductory dependent clause.
questions.explanation: The comma marks a brief pause after the introductory dependent clause Before the referee could blow the whistle.
questions.skill: Locating a comma after an introductory clause
questions.topic: Activity 1 of 9 (quiz/game): Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "At midnight, the power finally returned," what does the comma after midnight do?
choices: It separates an introductory time phrase from the main clause.
It sets off a nonessential phrase describing the power.
It marks a pause between two independent clauses.
It introduces a quoted word from an earlier source.
questions.explanation: The comma separates the short introductory phrase At midnight from the main clause, marking a brief pause.
questions.skill: Recognize a comma after an introductory phrase
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which punctuation mark in "The solution was simple—elegant" gives special emphasis to the final adjective?
choices: dash
comma
ellipsis
colon
questions.explanation: The dash isolates "elegant" so it receives heightened focus at the end of the sentence.
questions.skill: identify punctuation function
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: The editor shortened the witness's statement to The car was blue... it sped away. What do the three periods represent in this shortened quotation?
choices: A list of the car's remaining features
A deliberate silence before the car moved
Words omitted from the middle of the original statement
The point at which the statement becomes dialogue
questions.explanation: Because the statement is explicitly a shortened quotation, the ellipsis marks words removed from its middle.
questions.skill: Recognizing ellipses that represent omissions
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "The bell rang—everyone froze," what relationship does the dash help express?
choices: It introduces the title of a work being performed.
It links the ringing to the immediate reaction.
It marks an omitted item from a numbered list.
It separates a quotation from its speaker's name.
questions.explanation: The dash links the ringing of the bell to the immediate reaction, emphasizing the cause-and-effect relationship.
questions.skill: Interpret a dash as showing cause and effect
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model title The Journey Begins..., what effect does the ellipsis have?
choices: It marks a question the title asks about the journey.
It lists additional items connected with the journey.
It suggests that the journey continues beyond the title.
It separates the title from a subtitle.
questions.explanation: The ellipsis in a title suggests an action or journey that continues beyond the words shown.
questions.skill: Interpreting ellipses in titles
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: Which model sentence uses a comma to separate a direct address from the rest of the statement?
choices: Sailor; lower the anchor carefully.
Sailor lower, the anchor carefully.
Sailor, lower the anchor carefully.
Sailor: lower the anchor carefully.
questions.explanation: The comma marks the pause between the person being addressed and the command that follows.
questions.skill: Using commas for direct address
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the model sentence 'And then... everything changed,' what effect does the ellipsis create?
choices: It suggests that the change happened at a precise, predictable time.
It makes the change seem less important than the waiting.
It delays the key change and builds anticipation.
It indicates that the sentence continues with a list of events.
questions.explanation: The ellipsis creates a pause before the key change, making the reader wait to learn what changed.
questions.skill: Identifying ellipses that build anticipation
questions.topic: Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions

questions.prompt: In the sentence "There was only one sensible choice—run," what does the dash do?
choices: It introduces the title of a work being read.
It marks a pause between two quoted speakers.
It gives special emphasis to the command run.
It identifies a footnote's corresponding symbol.
questions.explanation: The dash isolates and emphasizes the command run, making the urgency of the choice stand out.
questions.skill: Recognize emphasis created by a dash
questions.topic: Notice It in a Model Text - Ellipses, Dashes, and Commas for Pauses and Omissions
